name: notion
title: Notion
summary: Pages, block children, data source and database queries, search and the bot user, with the Notion-Version header, page webhooks, and not-found, validation, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Notion's own OpenAPI 3.1 description (API version 2025-09-03, 24 operations), kept in its MCP server repository. Its page, block and query answers are untyped objects and it has no POST /v1/databases/{database_id}/query, so the hand-written subset gives richer offline answers.
